{{Quote|The individual who's volunteered the fighter isn't a Militia member. Yet. It's offered to fly escort on any job that we have, in order to demonstrate its loyalty and utility.|[[Osten Dal'Nay]], on Yve|<ref name="BotB" />}}
'''Yve''' was a [[Filordus]] who worked as an independent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Yve was a [[Gender/Legends|genderless]] individual who was referred to with it/its pronouns by the male [[Osten Dal'Nay]].<ref name="BotB" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Yve was hired by the [[Cularin Militia]] to escort the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of Militia-allied freelance agents, from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. On arrival on Caarimon, the agents discovered a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] on [[landing platform A-12]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Joventusek]], which had been left there by the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Blik (Shistavanen)|Blik]], and Yve remained with the craft while the agent searched Caarimon for a team of [[Believers]]. However, soon afterward Blik recovered his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and Yve and the Shistavanen susbequently engaged in a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] dogfight near to Caarimon.<ref name="BotB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yve was created [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and featured in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure, the players role-play as the Heroes of Cularin and they have the option of accepting an offer from the Cularin Militia to have Yve accompany them to Caarimon.<ref name="BotB" />
